constructora-saas.problem: Construction companies spread projects, budgets, and materials across spreadsheets and chats that don't talk to each other, losing sight of each project's real cost.
constructora-saas.solution: Multi-tenant backoffice with real per-organization isolation: projects, budgets, expenses, and inventory with reversible stock movements and reporting, all under roles and permissions validated at the API level.
constructora-saas.result: A complete system in production, with tenant-isolation tests and full traceability on every stock movement — not a CRUD with a login screen bolted on.

thumblify.problem: Producing consistent YouTube thumbnails takes time and iteration, and generic image generators don't understand the format or readability the platform demands.
thumblify.solution: A guided flow that turns title, style, color scheme, and up to two reference images into a multimodal prompt generated with Gemini, organized into a personal gallery or public community.
thumblify.result: A live end-to-end product: auth, generation, a private gallery, and a public community running on real-time polling, in Spanish and English.

ranch.problem: PDF or image menus go stale fast and force customers to rebuild their order by hand inside WhatsApp.
ranch.solution: A digital menu organized by category with order building, ingredient-level customization, and automatic WhatsApp message generation with branch, delivery, and full order detail.
ranch.result: A live mobile-first experience with reservations for two branches and orders that land in WhatsApp already formatted, with no account or app friction.

synttek.problem: A multidisciplinary agency needs to explain what it does, show real work, and generate inquiries without relying on social media alone.
synttek.solution: A bilingual platform with service pages, case studies, a blog, local landing pages, and a streaming conversational assistant that preps the handoff of each lead to WhatsApp.
synttek.result: A proprietary commercial platform in production, with full technical SEO (hreflang, sitemap, structured data) and a chatbot running on SSE events.

viajes-cordoba.problem: Travel agencies tend to present destinations as interchangeable lists, without conveying real judgment or knowledge of the territory.
viajes-cordoba.solution: An editorial catalog of six circuits, filterable by duration and traveler profile, with day-by-day itineraries and direct WhatsApp inquiries — a concept demo, not a real client.
viajes-cordoba.result: An editorial-direction exploration piece: real route navigation, scroll progress, and reduced-motion support, with sample data.

hotel-california.problem: Many hotels depend on booking-platform middlemen and lose brand identity on sites that are functional but undifferentiated.
hotel-california.solution: A cinematic landing page with parallax, animated metrics, and availability geared toward direct WhatsApp booking — a concept demo, not a real booking system.
hotel-california.result: A visual-direction piece: custom cursor, parallax, and GSAP/ScrollTrigger counters, with full reduced-motion support.

synttek-leads-engine.problem: Manual prospecting from Google Maps meant searching business by business, copying contact data by hand, and losing track of the sales follow-up.
synttek-leads-engine.solution: A full-stack platform that discovers local businesses via Google Places, enriches them with static scraping and Playwright to find WhatsApp and Instagram, scores each opportunity, and organizes everything in a CRM with Kanban and list views.
synttek-leads-engine.result: A functional MVP that centralizes discovery, prioritization, and follow-up into a single flow, replacing a manual, fragmented process with a structured, reusable pipeline.

01.description: I founded and run Synttek, a digital studio where I design and build products, sites, internal systems, and automations end to end. I've led more than 60 deliveries, connecting strategy, experience, code, and infrastructure to turn business needs into production-ready solutions.

02.description: I led the migration from Django Templates to Next.js, TypeScript, and Redux, establishing patterns the whole team adopted. I built a design system with 600+ components that cut development time by roughly 30%, improved product performance, and designed AI agent workflows to automate recruiting processes.

03.description: I built and shipped a production-ready MVP in three months, letting the team validate the business model with real users. I designed a data architecture for 10,000+ records, integrated external APIs, and turned Figma designs into a responsive, pixel-perfect experience.

04.description: I built five-plus custom WordPress solutions and optimized their architecture, caching, and images to cut load times by roughly 50%. I combined mobile-first development, technical SEO, and ongoing support, keeping a 100% client retention rate.

05.description: I designed and shipped full-stack applications on the MERN stack, with REST APIs, JWT auth, and real-time features via Socket.io. I owned the full lifecycle of each product, from definition and architecture through deployment with CI/CD and cloud infrastructure.
